prediction_horizon: Feature year T is joined to an independently computed distress event at T+1
source_rule: At least one of: losses for three consecutive years; accumulated losses exceeding contributed charter capital; negative shareholders' equity.

excluded_boundary_years.2015: 2014 net income unavailable for the three-consecutive-loss criterion at event year 2016

methodological_requirement: Year must denote feature year t and the target must be independently observed at t+1. Every positive row must be traceable to the triggering criterion and source document.
